task.title: Keep the `-short` test run fast with the relic benchmark tests
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M85). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

The relic benchmark tests add about 52 s of CPU to the ordinary `-short` run. The longest are `TestAddRelicFixtureIsDeterministic`, the `sha256` subtest and the storage test. `TestRelicManyPartLifecycle` takes about 11 s for each hash format. AGENTS.md asks for `-short` to stay quick.

## Wanted

Skip the second fixture build and the `sha256` subtest under `testing.Short()`.

## Done when

- The `-short` run of the affected packages is back near its time before the benchmark tests.
- The full run still covers what `-short` skips.
